Gandr (Gandr) is a Nordic curse-bullet spell in Type-Moon.
Hold cast to gather a curse sphere in front, release to fire it straight.
Higher charge raises curse tier, and higher proficiency shortens charge interval (down to 0.1s per stage).

Use Left Ctrl to switch to Gate Barrage mode: charge, then unleash a wall-like volley from behind.

magic.typemoonworld.unlimited_blade_work:
Reality Marble: Unlimited Blade Works.
The materialization of one's inner world.

I am the bone of my sword.
Steel is my body, and fire is my blood.
I have created over a thousand blades.
Unaware of loss.
Nor aware of gain.
Withstood pain to create weapons, waiting for one's arrival.
I have no regrets.
This is the only path.
My whole life was,
Unlimited Blade Works.

entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.attac: 搂7[Merlin] This is actually one of my specialties.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.avalo: 搂7[Merlin] Avalon isn't a place you can come and go as you please.
搂7[Merlin] Footsteps outside Avalon, please learn to look back first.
搂7[Merlin] A sky with no walls, no castle, no kingdom... I'll show you the rest next time.
搂7[Merlin] From the edge of paradise, let me tell you: your story is full of blessings.
搂7[Merlin] Only the sinless may pass. 'The Everdistant Utopia'!
§b[Merlin] The Inner Sea of the Planet. The Tower of Observation.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.buff_: §b[Merlin] Advance. I'll cover stamina, you provide output.
§b[Merlin] Don't rush. Keep pace and we'll win by endurance.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.cherr: 搂7[Merlin] Cherry blossom blizzard, suitable for a beginning, and an end.
搂7[Merlin] Cherry blossoms don't answer, but they always give the most beautiful ending.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.clone: 搂7[Merlin] Performance over, flowers scatter, people leave.
搂7[Merlin] A double appears閳ユ攧on't mistake the actor.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.comba: 搂7[Merlin] This attack is ineffective against Avalon.
搂7[Merlin] Lovely fireworks. Shame about the damage.
搂7[Merlin] Even if the world is destroyed, it is absolutely safe here.
搂7[Merlin] Don't waste your energy.
搂7[Merlin] Be a little quieter.
搂7[Merlin] It's not over yet.
搂7[Merlin] Hitting Avalon is basically punching the concept of 'no'.
搂7[Merlin] Strong force. Entirely wrong direction.
搂7[Merlin] Sorry, this barrier doesn't take feedback.
搂7[Merlin] Keep trying. You're getting very familiar with 'ineffective'.
搂7[Merlin] Just a clone... I'll leave the rest to you.
搂7[Merlin] Next time, I'll bring worse jokes.
搂7[Merlin] Retreat, retreat...
搂7[Merlin] See you next time.
搂7[Merlin] I'm going back to the tower to sleep.
搂7[Merlin] Is this it?
搂7[Merlin] Don't get proud. I never appear only once in a story.
搂7[Merlin] A curtain call, not the ending.
搂7[Merlin] Nicely done. Enjoy your restless night.
搂7[Merlin] Remember this moment. You'll miss me soon enough.
搂7[Merlin] Hah.
搂7[Merlin] Good work. Let us continue to the next act.
搂7[Merlin] How is that?
搂7[Merlin] Take this!
搂7[Merlin] This is where I excel.
搂7[Merlin] No worries, consider it a bonus.
搂7[Merlin] Hah! Haah!
搂7[Merlin] Not exactly my style, though...
搂7[Merlin] Then I'll be serious.
搂7[Merlin] You're rather rough.
搂7[Merlin] Trying to knock me down? My stamina lasts longer than you think.
搂7[Merlin] I took a detour. Stamina remains full.
搂7[Merlin] That fall means little. I can continue.
搂7[Merlin] I'm back. Continue.
搂7[Merlin] Don't expect me to tire first.
搂7[Merlin] Focus. I'm not ending this yet.
搂7[Merlin] Only my altitude dropped, not my condition.
搂7[Merlin] Not the end. Just halftime.
搂7[Merlin] Position corrected. Fight continues.
搂7[Merlin] Don't celebrate yet. The result isn't in.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.crowd: 搂7[Merlin] A crowd is convenient. I can explain this once.
搂7[Merlin] More people makes it easier to judge who falls first.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.death: 搂c[Merlin] Retreat, retreat... I'll leave the rest to you.
搂c[Merlin] I really was no help. Sorry about that...
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.envir: 搂7[Merlin] Hmm... The soil here isn't suitable for flowers.
搂7[Merlin] Night is a good time for flowers to bloom.
搂7[Merlin] The night favors petals閳ユ攣nd they will favor you.
搂7[Merlin] Nothingness... It's quite close to the 'ideal' skeleton.
搂7[Merlin] The thunder is too loud; it can't suppress the scent of flowers.
搂7[Merlin] Thunder is just noise, the scent of flowers is the star.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.escap: 搂c[Merlin] Oh my, entangled by roots.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.giveu: 搂7[Merlin] Good work. We'll stop here and continue the journey.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.greet: 搂7[Merlin] As you wish. Let us speak of the king's tale.
搂7[Merlin] There is a tiny window here.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.guard: §b[Merlin] Looks like it's my turn to take the stage.
§b[Merlin] The curtain rises閳ユ敄he sea of flowers is today's stage.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.heale: 搂7[Merlin] Hmm, good閳ユ敄he flowers can bloom a bit longer now.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.hosti: 搂c[Merlin] What a rude guest閳ユ攳et's show some real skill.
搂c[Merlin] Plenty of aggression, none of it accurate.
搂c[Merlin] You're reaching Avalon slower than you're reaching your grave.
搂c[Merlin] Fine. Leave your confidence here, you can go home.
搂c[Merlin] Politeness first閳ユ攼therwise the flowers won't be happy.
搂c[Merlin] With that attitude, even petals avoid you.
搂c[Merlin] Mistaking impulse for strength? I'll teach that one for free.
搂c[Merlin] Learn to look where you're going before swinging at me.
搂c[Merlin] You think you're challenging Merlin. You're challenging common sense.
搂c[Merlin] Tragic. You're this enthusiastic about losing.
搂c[Merlin] Keep charging. I could use the entertainment.
搂c[Merlin] Be polite and I might be gentle.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.idle: 搂7[Merlin] Move when timing is right. Wait when it isn't.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.idle_: 搂7[Merlin] Be patient. Good endings rarely rush.
搂7[Merlin] Avalon isn't far. Most people just pick the wrong direction.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.invis: 搂7[Merlin] Invisibility? I prefer showing my face.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.kill_: 搂7[Merlin] Hmm... Privilege of the creator? Let's stop here.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.low_h: 搂c[Merlin] Ah... It's been a while since proper exercise.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.menta: 搂7[Merlin] A little touch of the mind, don't be afraid.
搂7[Merlin] Don't be afraid, it's just a dream reminding you: you can be gentler.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.merli: 搂7[Merlin] I tell the joke first, then the conclusion. Both work.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.moon: 搂7[Merlin] The moon is perfect for weaving a little miracle.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.multi: 搂7[Merlin] Good work. Let's move on.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.playe: 搂7[Merlin] Looking at the flowers or me? Either is fine.
搂7[Merlin] Looking at me, or the flowers? Why not both.
搂c[Merlin] Don't push yourself. Only the living can dream.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.prank: 搂c[Merlin] Who told you to be so rude to flowers?
搂c[Merlin] Those who oppose flowers usually don't get applause.
搂7[Merlin] A little prank, take it as a refresher.
搂7[Merlin] A little joke, makes the flowers bloom better.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.rain: 搂7[Merlin] Rainy days aren't bad; the flowers look brighter.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_a: §b[Merlin] The primordial star shines in the depths below. Shall I show you where souls return?
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_b: 搂7[Merlin] Sleep, sleep. There's a ticket to Avalon in your dreams.
搂7[Merlin] There is a sea of flowers in the dream, don't forget to smile when you wake up.
搂7[Merlin] Want the longer version? I'm rather good at telling stories.
搂7[Merlin] Look through that little window and the story will unfold on its own.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_c: 搂7[Merlin] Gems can speak閳ユ攰f you are willing to listen.
搂7[Merlin] Polish carefully, dreams also need details.
搂7[Merlin] Time is a good friend閳ユ攣nd a good joke.
搂7[Merlin] Time is a good friend, and a good excuse.
搂7[Merlin] Pointing where? To a beautiful place, of course.
搂7[Merlin] Where it points, isn't as good as where the heart points.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_e: §b[Merlin] The Sword of the King閳ユ攩lowers will make way for it.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_f: 搂7[Merlin] Cherry blossoms? Yes, that's my specialty.
搂7[Merlin] Look, flowers always respond at the most appropriate time.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_h: 搂7[Merlin] The holy shroud covers, but also makes the story gentler.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_m: 搂7[Merlin] Scrolls are just signposts, you decide the scenery.
搂7[Merlin] You don't need a map to Avalon, just your heart.
搂7[Merlin] Roads not on the map often have better scenery.
搂7[Merlin] The one forging the blade is also forging fate.
搂c[Merlin] Be careful, those eyes will cut the 'story' too clean.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_r: 搂7[Merlin] Pick one, flowers never mind surprises.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.see_s: 搂7[Merlin] A shield is good. It still can't make decisions for you.
搂7[Merlin] Retreat when needed. Only the living get a next strike.
搂7[Merlin] Fine sword. The hand must be steadier.
搂7[Merlin] Fine blade, yes. More important: can you keep swinging to the end?
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.sleep: 搂c[Merlin] Have a restless dream, a small lesson.
§b[Merlin] Have a sweet dream, the flowers will keep watch.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.suppo: 搂7[Merlin] Stay sharp. You're still holding.
§b[Merlin] Hold a steady pace. I'll stretch this fight in your favor.
entity.typemoonworld.merlin.speech.targe: 搂7[Merlin] Cute閳ユ攤ut don't eat the flowers.
搂c[Merlin] A big boss entrance? I'll turn the stage lights up.
搂c[Merlin] The bigger they are, the funnier the fall.
搂c[Merlin] You handle the roaring. I'll handle the ending.
搂c[Merlin] Heavy crown, isn't it? Let me help you bow.
搂c[Merlin] A legendary foe? Perfect for a legendary sea of flowers.
搂c[Merlin] Easy now. Epic battles usually end on my cue.
搂7[Merlin] Explosions? I can do that too. Let me show you a rain of flowers.
搂7[Merlin] Explosion is rough art, flowers are a refined counterattack.
搂c[Merlin] Yo, a legend. Let's have a legendary sea of flowers.
搂7[Merlin] Teleportation? Mine is more elegant.
搂7[Merlin] I'm more familiar with 'elegant movement'.
搂7[Merlin] The more the merrier; a flower banquet is livelier with a crowd.
搂7[Merlin] Even iron blocks can be softened by flowers閳ユ攷etaphorically speaking.
搂7[Merlin] Nightmares of the sky... let's decorate with some petals.
搂c[Merlin] Drawing your blade at me? Brave choice, poor judgment.
搂c[Merlin] You picked me as your final boss? Better save often.
搂c[Merlin] Relax. I'll let you lose with dignity.
搂c[Merlin] Nice killing intent. Shame about aim and manners.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Too slow.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Hmph.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] The air here, full of rot and sulfur.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] ...Not bad.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] That's enough.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Backing off... for now.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Meddling... but, thanks.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] The obstacle has been removed.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] This level... isn't enough to kill me.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Noble Phantasm...? It does hurt a bit.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Boring... isn't there anything worth cutting?
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] 搂4Running is useless.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] 搂4As long as it's alive, even a god can be killed.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Left arm... is gone...
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] The prosthetic... is it broken...
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Don't stare.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] This feeling... I'm not used to it.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Even with one hand, I can still kill you.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] It hurts... just kidding.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Need a new prosthetic...
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] This is a bit... troublesome.

搂c[Ryougi Shiki] ...Tch.

搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Even with one hand, I can still kill you.

搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Prosthetic broken... Touko is going to complain again.

搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Don't block the way!

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Hey, look at you... you're dying.

搂c[Ryougi Shiki] 搂4...Refused.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] My fate... I decide it.
搂c[Ryougi Shiki] Brute force... meaningless.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Retrieved.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Retrieved.

搂7[Ryougi Shiki] The atmosphere here... is wrong.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] A crude trap.
搂7[Ryougi Shiki] Whatever it is, if it's an obstacle, I'll cut it.
